question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fulfeel"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is **"Fulfill" **which means to complete or achieve something. (पूरा करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She worked hard to fulfill her dreams of becoming a doctor.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Altogether **(कुल मिलाकर): Completely or in total.

 
 
• **Example:** Altogether, it was a very successful event.
 
 
 
• **Always **(हमेशा ): At all times; on all occasions.
 
 
• **Example: **She always arrives on time for meetings.
 
 
 
• **Until** (तक): Up to the point in time or the event mentioned.
 
 
• **Example:** You should wait here until I come back.
